title: Think Before You Restore: Risk-Aware Manchu Manuscript Restoration with Stroke-Guided Attention
abstract: arXiv:2609.36243v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Full-page blind restoration of historical Manchu manuscripts is challenging due to scarce annotations, unknown degradation regions, and fragile connected strokes. Generic restoration models may improve visual quality but often modify intact content, leading to over-restoration. We propose SAGE-Restore (Stroke-Aware Gated rEstoration), a selective restoration framework that first assesses where restoration is needed and then uses this assessment to guide restoration candidate generation and pixel-level selection. Its encoder predicts patch-level repair probabilities from complementary appearance and stroke-structural cues to condition restoration candidate generation, while the corresponding repair logits are refined into a pixel-level soft gate that selectively controls where the restoration candidate is applied. translated_title: 三思而后修：基于笔画引导注意力的风险感知满文手稿修复
translated_abstract: 对历史满文手稿进行全页盲修复极具挑战性，原因在于标注数据稀缺、退化区域未知以及相连笔画十分脆弱。通用修复模型虽然可以提升视觉质量，但往往会修改原本完好的内容，造成过度修复。我们提出SAGE-Restore（笔画感知门控修复），这是一种选择性修复框架，它首先评估哪些区域需要修复，然后利用该评估结果指导修复候选的生成和像素级的选择。其编码器从互补的外观线索与笔画结构线索中预测补丁级的修复概率，以此对修复候选生成进行条件约束；同时，相应的修复逻辑值被进一步细化为像素级软门控，选择性地控制修复候选应用的区域。我们还进一步引入了一种保真度感知的评估协议，联合衡量退化区域的恢复效果与完好内容的保护……
tldr: 该论文提出SAGE-Restore框架，先通过外观与笔画结构线索评估退化位置，再用像素级软门控选择性应用修复结果，从而在满文手稿修复中同时实现退化区域恢复与完好内容保护，避免过度修复。
en_tdlr: SAGE-Restore is a selective restoration framework for Manchu manuscripts that first predicts where repair is needed from appearance and stroke-structural cues, then uses a pixel-level soft gate to selectively apply restoration, recovering degraded regions while preserving intact content and avoiding over-restoration.
